metadata.description: The generic engine for AI-driven issue automation across Umbraco products — orchestration, GitHub/CI ops, gated merge, cross-repo dispatch, and the self-learning loop. Product-agnostic: each consumer supplies only a build playbook + a config block. Extracted from the umbraco-mcp-ops prototype.

plugins.name: issue-loop-core
plugins.description: The orchestration engine: work a backlog of ready-for-ai issues to CI-green PRs. Owns the durable /goal loop, rolling cap-3 dispatch, the human-review-response phase, model selection, and stop conditions/backstops. Loads a product's build playbook via a named slot (it does not know how to build any one product). Bundles rework-loop (PR-review-event response). Repo-agnostic; requires github-ops.

plugins.name: github-ops
plugins.description: Shared how-to for GitHub work in both environments (gh CLI + git locally, the GitHub MCP server on Claude web) PLUS a CI-provider abstraction with github-checks and azure-pipelines implementations. One operation catalog; the loop plugins point here instead of re-explaining the dual path. Required by every loop.

plugins.name: loop-dispatch
plugins.description: Single front door so one routine per repo can handle every loop event. Deterministically routes each triggering GitHub event to the matching loop via route-event.sh; a non-matching event is a quiet no-op. Supports a target_repo distinct from the event's repo (the cross-repo-issues case, e.g. Forms). Router only; each loop owns its guardrails.

plugins.name: merge-flow
plugins.description: Guardrail loop that merges PRs labelled auto-merge (the maintainer's deliberate go-signal) only once they are also CI-green, conflict-free, on the right base, and free of an unresolved 'changes requested'. Replaces error-prone manual merges. Repo-agnostic; local or scheduled cloud routine.

plugins.name: learning
plugins.description: The self-learning machinery: read-only capture hooks (SubagentStop/SessionEnd) that file proto-learning issues off the critical path, the proto-learning schema, and triage-learnings (dedupe + threshold + route to owning repo / shared-skills PR / loop-improvement issue). Mechanism is generic; the inbox repo and routing table are per-consumer config.

plugins.name: release-flow
plugins.description: Branching, merge, release, and dev-sync workflow skills for any repo — detects gitflow (dev + main) vs main-only. Reference/default only: products with bespoke release conventions (Forms, Automate) override with their own release skills.

plugins.name: dotnet-web-runtime
plugins.description: Cloud-environment setup that lets a .NET product run as a Claude web routine: the dotnet-restore internal-NuGet-feed proxy / 401 fix and SessionStart wiring. Needed by any .NET consumer (Forms, Automate); TypeScript products don't need it.
